question: Should this PR land with terminal production-hook proof for the compaction fallback boundary, or should maintainers require a live two-agent timing capture first?
rationale: The patch appears technically correct and focused, but it changes a session-state/message-delivery replay boundary where green CI cannot fully settle the intermittent live timing behavior.

options.title: Land With Scoped Proof
options.body: Accept the terminal production-hook proof and focused regressions as sufficient for this non-visual runtime boundary.

options.title: Request Live Two-Agent Proof
options.body: Ask for a real two-agent compaction recovery run showing one delivered reply and preserved safe source context before merge.

options.title: Pause For Boundary Review
options.body: Pause if maintainers want replay safety owned by a broader transcript/API boundary instead of this local fallback filter.

recommendation.title: Land With Scoped Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the terminal production-hook proof and focused regressions as sufficient for this non-visual runtime boundary.
